options.name: label
options.description: Legend of the fieldset (required accessible name).

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the legend; it stays the accessible name.

options.name: value
options.description: The rule; null means "Does not repeat". Also the value restored by reset().

options.name: start
options.description: Series start: defaults, the minimum end date, and the preview.

options.name: frequencies
options.description: Frequencies offered. Default all four.

options.name: maxInterval
options.description: Largest interval.

options.name: maxCount
options.description: Largest occurrence count.

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name of the hidden input (iCalendar text).

options.name: description
options.description: Help text referenced by the fieldset.

options.name: required
options.description: "Does not repeat" is invalid.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disables every control; not submitted.

options.name: firstDayOfWeek
options.description: First weekday toggle. Default: the locale's first day of week.

options.name: validate
options.description: Consumer validation after built-in checks.

options.name: formControl
options.description: Advanced, read at creation: false skips registration with Form (Schedule Picker registers itself).

options.name: icons
options.description: Icon slot overrides.

options.name: validationTiming
options.description: When validation messages first appear.

options.name: previewCount
options.description: Next occurrences listed under the summary (needs start); 0 hides the preview.

options.name: locale
options.description: Month and weekday names, dates, numbers, the first day of the week, and messages.

options.name: timezone
options.description: Timezone of the start wall-clock time, the preview, and UNTIL.

options.name: disambiguation
options.description: DST policy for wall-clock times in a gap or overlap (SPEC section 8.5).

options.name: direction
options.description: Reading direction; Left/Right arrow keys and chevrons follow it.

properties.name: fieldset
properties.description: The labelled fieldset holding every control.

properties.name: untilPicker
properties.description: The end-date Date Picker (not registered with Form).

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current rule; null when not repeating or invalid (a custom error keeps the value).

properties.name: summary
properties.description: Localized description of the current rule.

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: The rule text differs from the initial value.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left the control at least once.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Programmatic value (no events), kept exactly; clears an external custom error.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error; cleared when the user edits.

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: iCalendar text, or null when not repeating or invalid.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear state (no events).

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, the inner Date Picker, listeners, and registration.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The user changed the rule or its validity error.
